name: 365 day BiL eligibility
description: Creates and approves a 2-year apprenticeship for Riley Brooks (DOB 2008-01-01, start 2026-04-01). PUTs a break in learning starting on day 182 (pause 2026-09-29), resuming 2028-01-01. The learner accrues 183 more actual days post-break, reaching 365 total on withdrawal date 2028-07-01. The 365-day incentive milestone is reached — both incentive payments should be generated. Then moves the withdrawal back one day to 2028-06-30 (364 total days) — both incentives should be removed. Finally moves the return date forward one day to 2027-12-31, restoring 365 total days — both incentives should be regenerated. Then moves the withdrawal back one day to 2028-06-29 (364 total days) — both incentives should be removed again. Finally lengthens the break by one day (pause 2026-09-30), restoring 365 total days — both incentives should be regenerated.
